Storage space: {{Aqua|27}} items |auctionable5 = n |function5 = Provides additional storage for minions. |sell5 = 40000 |raw_materials5 = *42304 Oak Log *2 Minion Storage X-pender |mat_cost_bazaar5 = 264 Enchanted Oak Log |bazaar_not_including5 = {{Item|Minion Storage X-pender|amount=2|image=|noimgpad=y}} |raw_materials_upgr5 = 1 Minion Storage X-pender |id5 = xxlarge_enchanted_chest |bazaar5=XX-Large Storage }} '''Minion Storages''' are a type of chest for [[Minions]], used when they run out of inventory space. They are not [[Minion Upgrades]], but are instead placed next to a minion. == Usage == {{Affected Minions List|misc|all|preamble_text=n}}'''Minion Storages''' can be placed on any side of a Minion (but not under and above the minion), which will increase the effective storage capacity of the Minion based on the type of '''Minion Storage''' used. {| class="wikitable" !'''Minion Storage''' type !Added Storage |- |Small |3 slots |- |{{Green|Medium}} |9 slots |- |{{blue|Large}} |15 slots |- |{{purple|X-Large}} |21 slots |- |{{red|XX-Large}} |27 slots |} If [[Automated Shipping]] is used, it will only sell after both the Minion's inventory and chest are filled. Note that [[Hopper]]s do '''not''' work on '''Minion Storages''' as the items are not stored in the vanilla chest representing the '''Minion Storage'''. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{/Table}} == Game Messages == {|class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Message |- | Placing a '''Minion Storage''' not next to a minion | {{Dialogue|&cYou need to place this next to a minion!}} |- | Placing a '''Minion Storage''' next to a normal chest | {{Dialogue|&cYou can't place minion storage next to another chest!}} |- | Placing a '''Minion Storage''' next to a trapped chest | {{Dialogue|&cYou can't place this next to other chests!}} |- | Placing a '''Minion Storage''' next to another '''Minion Storage''' | {{Dialogue|&cYou can't place a chest here!}} |- | Placing a '''Minion Storage''' next to minions that all already have '''Minion Storages''' | {{Dialogue|&cThis minion already has a chest!}} |} == Tips == *Medium storages are used the most often because they are cheap and provide decent storage space. *It is best used with compactors. == Bugs == * Items can be put into the vanilla chest representing the '''Minion Storage''' with a dropper and taken out with a hopper. ** This does '''not''' put items in the minion's storage, but in the vanilla chest that is used to represent the '''Minion Storage'''. ** A hopper cannot put items into the representing chest. ** Items put into the representing chest are saved and will still be there after reloading the island. ** Breaking the '''Minion Storage''' or picking up the accompanying minion will make any items in the representing chest drop on the ground. == Trivia == * The game messages about not being able to place '''Minion Storages''' next to other chests take priority over needing to place it next to a minion. * Placing a Large Storage chest grants the achievement {{AchievementLink|Bigger Storage is Seeded}}. * A newly placed minion storage links to the first minion it finds while checking the cardinal directions in the following order: south, west, north, east (from the perspective of the chest). == Gallery == UpgradedMin.png|A Cobblestone Minion with a Minion Storage beside it. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.1|Added Small, Medium and requirement for '''Medium Storage''' from {{CollectionLink|Oak Log VII}} to {{CollectionLink|Oak Log VI}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Minion Modifiers}}
